newsitem.title: MEXICO: Iusacell says closes two debt deals.
newsitem.headline: Iusacell says closes two debt deals.

text.p: Meixcan cellular telephone operator Grupo Iusacell SA said on Monday that it had closed two debt deals worth $375 million.
The company said that it had raised $150 million with a seven-year bond carrying a coupon of 10 percent.
It also raised $225 million with a five-year syndicated bank financing at Libor plus 1.75 percent.
That consisted of a $125 million term loan, which was fully disbursed, and a $100 million revolving credit which will be available over the next year, the company said in a statement.
The deals are to be used to refinance about $210 million of existing debt as well as to fund the company's capital expenditures for the rest of 1997 and part of 1998.

"The extended maturities of this new debt more closely match our asset base, and the attractvue pricing significantly lowers our funding costs," said Howard Zuckerman, chief financial officer for the company.
